security_audit.summary: Most static detections are expected for an environment configuration skill and were adjudicated as placeholders, documentation, or local configuration access. Confirmed issues include remote installer commands piped to a shell, unguarded helper output writes, and examples that can print decrypted secrets or connection strings. No prompt injection text was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly to a shell.
remediation.suggestion: Replace curl-to-shell examples with package-manager installation, pinned downloads, or checksum verification before execution.

remediation.issue: Decrypted secrets and environment differences can be printed to stdout.
remediation.suggestion: Redact values for sensitive keys, require explicit confirmation for display, and prefer secure output files with restricted permissions.

remediation.issue: Encryption passwords can be supplied on the command line.
remediation.suggestion: Remove or discourage the --password flag and use getpass, stdin from a secret manager, or environment-specific secure input.

remediation.issue: Helper commands write to user-supplied output paths without overwrite guards.
remediation.suggestion: Refuse to overwrite existing files unless a force flag is provided, validate output paths, and set restrictive file permissions.

remediation.issue: Secret rotation guidance creates a plaintext .env backup.
remediation.suggestion: Encrypt backups, store them outside the repository with restricted permissions, and delete them automatically after verification.

content.value_statement: Python projects often leak secrets or drift across environments. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structured guidance for UV projects, .env files, validation, and secret handling.
actual_capabilities: Set up UV-based Python project configuration with dotenv and validation dependencies.
Create and document .env templates for development, staging, and production settings.
Validate required environment variables and explain missing configuration values.
Compare environment files and generate templates from existing local files.
Encrypt and decrypt local secrets files using the included helper script.
Provide testing and troubleshooting guidance for configuration loading failures.
limitations: It does not provide a hosted secret manager or cloud credential vault.
The helper script operates on local files and can overwrite outputs when directed.
Some examples require users to supply secure real values and rotate them externally.
Remote installer commands should be reviewed before use in sensitive environments.

use_cases.title: Bootstrap a Python Service
use_cases.description: Create a UV project with clean environment templates, dotenv loading, and required variable validation.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Configuration
use_cases.description: Define shared .env templates, gitignore rules, and environment naming conventions for multiple developers.

use_cases.title: Audit Secret Handling
use_cases.description: Review local configuration files for placeholder secrets, missing variables, and unsafe storage patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Env Template
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new project
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a .env.template for my Python UV project. Include application settings, database configuration, logging, and placeholders for API keys.

prompt_templates.title: Add Config Validation
prompt_templates.prompt: Add a Python configuration module that loads .env files, validates required variables, and gives clear errors when settings are missing.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Environments
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare my development and production environment settings. Identify missing variables, mismatched names, and values that should not be shared.

prompt_templates.title: Design Secret Rotation
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a safe secret rotation workflow for this UV Python project. Include validation, rollback, audit steps, and guidance for avoiding plaintext leaks.

output_examples.input: Set up configuration for a new FastAPI service using UV.
output: A recommended dependency list for dotenv, validation, and testing support.
A template structure for required application, database, and secret settings.
A short checklist for gitignore, validation, and test coverage.

output_examples.input: Review two environment files before a production deploy.
output: A summary of variables missing from either environment.
A list of settings that need production-safe values.
Warnings for secret values that should be redacted or stored elsewhere.

output_examples.input: Plan secret encryption for a small team project.
output: A local encryption workflow with password handling guidance.
A rotation checklist for API keys and database credentials.
Recommendations to avoid printing decrypted secrets in logs.

best_practices: Keep committed templates separate from local files that contain real secrets.
Validate required variables at startup and fail before the application handles requests.
Redact secret values in terminal output, logs, examples, and support messages.
anti_patterns: Committing .env, secrets.json, or production-specific configuration files.
Copying remote install commands into automation without reviewing the downloaded script.
Passing encryption passwords as command-line arguments or printing decrypted secrets.

faq.question: Does this skill store secrets for me?
faq.answer: No. It provides local patterns and helper utilities. Use a dedicated secret manager for production storage.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Is python-dotenv required?
faq.answer: Many examples use python-dotenv, but you can adapt the patterns to another configuration loader.

faq.question: Does it support multiple environments?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents development, staging, production, and local override patterns.

faq.question: Can the helper script modify files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can write templates, merged environment files, encrypted files, and decrypted outputs.

faq.question: What should I review before using it?
faq.answer: Review commands that install tools, write files, decrypt secrets, or print configuration values.
